snippet.title: Hellboy Joins Brawlhalla (Reveal Trailer)
snippet.description:
All hell is breaking loose with Hellboy joining the fight in #Brawlhalla! We’re celebrating this Epic Crossover event with characters from the new #Hellboy movie, including Nimue, Daimio, and Gruagach, a new game mode, a new Hellboy themed map, bonus login Gold, and more!

! Follow Brawlhalla EVERYWHERE !
